sections.heading: How to Place?
sections.text:
-> Placement

Place the frame in your living room, office, or workspace where it is clearly visible. For best Vastu alignment, position it in the South or East direction to support success, growth, and forward movement.
-> Direction of Horses

Ensure the horses are facing inside the room and not towards the exit. This represents opportunities, progress, and success energy flowing into your space.
-> LED Usage

Switch on the LED light during evenings or work hours to enhance the energy presence and visual impact of the frame. It helps create a more active and vibrant environment.
-> Care & Maintenance

Gently clean with a soft, dry cloth to maintain its shine and detailing. Avoid water and harsh chemicals to preserve the finish and structure.
✨ Pro Tip: Set a clear intention while placing it—focus on career growth, financial success, or stability for better alignment.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 ✨ Success | Vastu Energy | Prosperity Flow

Invite powerful success energy and forward momentum into your space with this 7 Horse Vastu Pyrite Neon LED Frame, thoughtfully designed to combine Vastu principles, crystal energy, and modern décor aesthetics. Crafted with precision, this piece features a 5mm sunboard front for a clean, vibrant visual finish and a 2mm MDF back board for durability and structure, making it both visually striking and long-lasting.

The design showcases 7 running horses, a powerful Vastu symbol known for career growth, financial success, recognition, and continuous progress. 

What elevates this piece further is the Pyrite crystal placement, widely known as the “wealth magnet”, associated with abundance, confidence, and strong decision-making energy. The addition of NEON LED lighting enhances the overall aura, creating a glowing, high-energy focal point that brings life and positivity to your surroundings.

Whether placed in your living room, office, or workspace, this frame works as both a powerful energy tool and a premium décor statement, aligning your environment with success-driven energy.

Key Highlights 🔥

• Pyrite Crystal Energy – Known for attracting wealth, confidence, and abundance

• LED Illuminated Design – Enhances visual appeal and energetic presence

• Modern Luxury Décor – Perfect blend of energy, design, and aesthetics

• Comes with a 12V DC adapter included, ready to use for smooth and hassle-free LED operation.

Brought to you by India’s biggest crystal home décor brand, ensuring authenticity, premium craftsmanship, and powerful energy alignment ✨

✨ DisclaimerCrystals are believed to support harmony, energy flow, and positivity. They work best when combined with intention, effort, and a balanced lifestyle.
